request: Make a short warm video that explains why bees matter for the food on our plate. Mention pollination.
summary: A 12-second warm explainer that tells a general audience bees pollinate a third of our food, ending on a call to protect them.

goals.text: Viewer learns that bees pollinate about a third of our food
goals.success_check: Narration says bee pollination feeds a third of our food; a bee on a flower is shown while it is said

goals.text: Viewer feels moved to care about bees
goals.success_check: Closing scene has a gentle call to protect them

non_goals.text: No statistics beyond 'a third of our food'

scenarios.situation: sees the first 3 seconds with sound off
scenarios.outcome: understands the topic from picture and subtitles alone

assumptions: Narrator voice is neutral and calm

open_questions.question: Should the narrator voice be feminine, masculine or neutral?

improvements.title: Add soft background music
improvements.benefit: Warmer mood; masks silence between lines
improvements.rationale: Cheap and lifts a short piece; narration stays clearly on top

improvements.title: Animate the opening shot from a generated still
improvements.rationale: Adds a dependent job that can fail; not needed for 12 seconds
